title: 茶水间英文 - 11月12日 | 黄仁勋或遭罢免、和谈入莫斯科、日本食品减税
description:
The Wall Street Journal reports that Nvidia's board is preparing to oust chief executive Jensen Huang after a fast-moving scandal, sending the chip giant's shares down around eight percent. Meanwhile, US peace envoys arrive in Moscow for talks with Vladimir Putin, and Japan moves to cut the tax on food from eight percent to one percent. Plus a random question: if you could relive any one day of your life, which day would you pick?

华尔街日报报道，英伟达董事会在丑闻迅速发酵后正准备罢免首席执行官黄仁勋，英伟达股价盘前下跌约8%。与此同时，美国和平特使抵达莫斯科与普京会谈，日本则推动把食品消费税从8%降至1%。今天还有一个随机问题：如果你能重新经历人生中的某一天，你会选哪一天？

Words to steal 生词本：
- successor — 继任者；接班人
- waiting in the wings — 在幕后待命；随时准备接手
- sticking point — 僵持不下的关键点；症结
- steer the conversation — 引导谈话方向
- prisoner exchange — 换俘；交换战俘
- on brand — 很符合某人一贯的风格
- cost of living — 生活成本
- relive — 重新经历；重温
